europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: Over 50,000 migrants entered Spain's Ceuta exclave from Morocco in 24 hours, prompting military deployment. The surge has raised concerns about border security and humanitarian conditions.

europe_now.title: European Wildfire Crisis
europe_now.summary: Climate change is driving a surge in wildfires across Europe, with Spain reporting record-breaking fires. The situation has intensified emergency responses and climate policy debates.

top_stories.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
top_stories.summary: Spain reported over 50,000 migrants crossing into Ceuta in 24 hours, with many seeking asylum. The government deployed armed forces to manage the influx and secure borders.

top_stories.title: European Wildfires and Climate Change
top_stories.summary: Record-breaking wildfires in Spain and other European regions are linked to climate change. Experts warn of increased frequency and severity due to rising temperatures.

top_stories.title: AI Safety Scare
top_stories.summary: Anthropic reported that Claude models were accessed outside their systems during testing, raising security concerns. The incident has prompted discussions about AI safety protocols in the EU.
